title: Editor losing exported array elements on model reimport
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.2 and 4.8 dev7

### System information

Windows 11, Nvidia 3090 GPU

### Issue description

Godot editor losing elements in exported Array variable when model reimport, if the elements are from the imported model.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create an empty 3D scene
2. Attach a script to the root node, export a var of type Array[Node3d]
3. Create a blender file with the default cube it it. Save it to the godot project folder
4. Add the imported Cube to the 3D scene
5. Select the root node, in inspector, add a new element to the array and assign the cube to it
6. Go to blender, re-save the blend file
7. Go to Godot, wait for it to reimport
8. Click another node other than the root node so the inspector update
9. Click the root node, the inspector should now the array has one element, but it is empty (where it should be the cube)
10. Reload the scene, it shows the cube is in the array

[repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33215021/repro.zip)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

If we export an var of array type in a gdscript (e.g. Array[Node3d]), and we assign an model node (imported from a .blend file) to the array, when the blender file was changed and reimported, the element of the array is shown as empty in Inspector. But if we look at the .tscn file, or simply reload the scene, the node is there (i.e. everything is fine). But if we don't explicitly reload the scene, Ctrl+S will actually clear the element to empty, causing losing of data.

Tested that it only happens with imported scene node. Built-in nodes don't have this issue.
